boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's os_reset.c, 0x02059dd4..0x02059eb0: 3 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt, each identified by its body against pret's pokediamond OS_reset.c. OS_InitReset sets OSi_IsInitReset once, runs PXI_Init, waits for PXI_IsCallbackReady(PXI_FIFO_TAG_OS, PXI_PROC_ARM7) and installs OSi_CommonCallback. OSi_CommonCallback sets OSi_IsResetOccurred on OS_PXI_COMMAND_RESET (0x10) and calls OS_Terminate otherwise. OSi_SendToPxi retries PXI_SendWordByFifo(PXI_FIFO_TAG_OS, data << 8, FALSE) until it succeeds.

Order: pret's file defines OS_InitReset, OSi_CommonCallback and OSi_SendToPxi first. mwccarm emits the bodies in reverse, so OSi_SendToPxi is lowest and OS_InitReset highest. The rest of the file is ITCM code, not arm9 .text: config/arm9/itcm/symbols.txt has OSi_DoBoot, OSReadROMArea, OSi_ReloadRomData and OS_ResetSystem at 0x01ffdb28..0x01ffde00, and src/OSi_ReloadRomData.c defines OS_ResetSystem, which calls OSi_SendToPxi(0x10).

BOTTOM EDGE: func_02059d98 (0x02059d98..0x02059dd4), an uncalled asm zero-fill of 32-byte blocks. It is not pret's OSi_CpuClear32, which stores one data word at a time, and nothing ties it to this file or to os_system.c below it, so it stays its own source.
TOP EDGE: OS_GetOwnerInfo at 0x02059eb0, the lowest of os_ownerInfo.c (arm9/OS_OwnerInfo).
notes: Hand-assembled, following arm9/FS_Rom: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main.
C, like the shards it replaces (src/OSi_SendToPxi.c, src/OSi_CommonCallback.c, src/OS_InitReset.c), which were already named.
Text-only. OSi_IsInitReset and OSi_IsResetOccurred keep their owners.
